answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the onyx of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The garden is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the quill. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work.
